must_read.title: Leveraging Mendelian Randomisation for Causal Inference in Endodontics
must_read.title_zh: 利用孟德尔随机化进行牙髓病学因果推断
must_read.one_line: 纳入10项MR研究，类风湿关节炎对牙髓病因果效应最一致但缺乏生物学特异性与可重复性，其余多为null或边缘结果。
must_read.so_what: q1巨噬细胞极化之外，成骨细胞自身RCD也是骨丢失驱动因素；实验管线（scRNA+DIA+AAV）…
must_read.caution: P. gingivalis体外感染model不能完整模拟人体根尖感染生态
must_read.abstract: BACKGROUND: Endodontic diseases have been linked to many potential risk factors and systemic conditions. However, observational associations may reflect sources of bias such as confounding and reverse causality. Mendelian randomisation (MR) can strengthen causal inference, although its assumptions require scrutiny. OBJECTIVES: To provide an overview of MR in endodontic research and synthesise evidence specifically on causal relationships of endodontic diseases. METHOD: PubMed/MEDLINE, Web of Science and Scopus were searched to May 2026. The narrative component established MR's conceptual and analytical framework, including core assumptions, MR designs, data sources, instrument selection, estimators, diagnostics, implementation and appraisal of MR evidence. Original MR studies involving endodontic diseases were identified and compared by phenotype, data source, direction, estimates, replication and assumption support. RESULTS: The narrative part of the review mapped MR from formulation of a causal question and basic principles to credibility assessment, emphasising the distinction between statistical robustness and biological validity when interpreting causal claims. The systematic search identified 10 studies (2023-2025). Rheumatoid arthritis liability showed the most consistent positive association with endodontic outcomes, but effects were biologically non-specific and unreplicated. Other systemic exposures were mainly null, heterogeneous, borderline or unreplicated; evidence that endodontic disease causes systemic outcomes was limited to isolated findings, including a single lacunar-stroke analysis. Core assumption appraisal showed that instrument relevance was generally well supported from a solely statistical perspective, with most studies using genome-wide instrument selection, reporting strength metrics and drawing on large GWAS datasets. Independence was also addressed in many analyses through ancestry matching, linkage disequilibrium control and confounder screening. The principal limitation concerned exclusion restriction: shared biological pathways and broad pulp and periapical phenotypes often weakened biological specificity and plausibility, while absent colocalisation, relaxed or sparse instrument selection and limited replication left horizontal pleiotropy unresolved. CONCLUSION: MR offers a valuable framework for generating and testing causal

deep.title_zh: 利用孟德尔随机化进行牙髓病学因果推断
deep.one_sentence: 纳入10项MR研究，类风湿关节炎对牙髓病因果效应最一致但缺乏生物学特异性与可重复性，其余多为null或边缘结果。
deep.question: 系统性暴露因素与牙髓/根尖周疾病之间是否存在可验证的因果关系，而非仅由混杂或反向因果驱动的观察性关联？
deep.design: 叙述性框架+系统检索的综合性综述，检索PubMed/WoS/Scopus至2026年5月，纳入2023–2025年间以GWAS为数据源的孟德尔随机化原始研究进行对比合成。
deep.sample_desc: 非原始研究；纳入10项MR研究，均基于大型GWAS汇总统计量（具体样本量摘要未说明）。

findings.claim: 类风湿关节炎遗传风险与牙髓/根尖周不良结局呈最一致的正向关联，但该效应生物学特异性差且未被独立复制。
findings.evidence: 在所有纳入研究中效应方向最为一致，但作者判定其属于"biologically non-specific and unreplicated"

findings.claim: 其他系统性暴露对牙髓病的作用多为null、异质、边缘或不可重复。
findings.evidence: 综述综合显示其余暴露的因果证据以null或borderline为主，未形成稳定模式

findings.claim: 反向因果方向（牙髓病导致系统性疾病）的证据极为有限，仅有孤立发现。
findings.evidence: 唯一提到的是单项腔隙性脑梗死分析，提示牙髓病可能因果性影响该终点，但属孤证

findings.claim: 工具变量在统计学相关性上普遍良好，独立性也多有控制，但排除限制（无水平多效性）是核心局限。
findings.evidence: 多数研究采用全基因组显著性阈值选IV、报告F统计量、进行 ancestry matching与LD pruning；colocalisation缺失、IV选择宽松使pleiotropy无法排除

deep.effect: 未报告统一效应量；单项RA liability估计值摘要未说明具体OR/β及CI
deep.relation: 与 q2（牙周炎/口腔感染通过哪些通路影响全身疾病）相关；本文提供因果推断视角的工具箱与现有证据盘点，指出"类风湿关节炎→牙髓病"方向的因果信号虽存在但缺乏生物学机制解释，不能据此建立因果通路假说。
deep.why: 它是目前第一篇系统梳理孟德尔随机化在牙髓病学应用的综述，明确区分了"统计稳健≠生物有效"这一关键认知陷阱；并给出因果声明的可信度评估框架（IV相关性→独立性→排除限制的逐级检验），对想做因果推断但尚未厘清MR假设边界的研究生具有直接的方法学参照价值。
limitations: 仅纳入英文数据库，发表偏倚与灰色文献缺失未被定量评估（作者承认）。
根尖周表型定义宽泛、缺乏标准化临床分层，导致不同研究的phenotype not comparable，因果信号可能只是统计噪音的聚集。
纳入研究时间窗口极窄（2023–2025），MR方法迭代快，部分早期研究所用的弱IV与单一 estimator 在当前标准下可能被重新判定为不可靠。
deep.transferable: 可直接借鉴其在 MR 可信度评估表格中对三项核心假设（relevance/independence/exclusion restriction）逐项打分的方法；同时可把其"GWAS来源+全基因组IV+多 estimator 敏感性分析"的标准工作流移植到自己关注的相关因果推断课题中。
followups: 哪些 GWAS 队列覆盖了牙周炎/根尖周炎的欧洲与非欧洲人群？样本量与表型定义是否达到 MR 最小检出效力门槛？
能否找到针对 IL-1β 轴或巨噬细胞极化关键基因的 eQTL/pQTL 作为更特异性的 instrument，以替代当前用 RA liability 这种宽谱表型所面临的 pl…
colocalisation 分析在哪些根尖周相关位点已有现成数据（如 GWAS Catalog / COLOC 仓库），可否复用而无需重新跑全套四步法？

must_reads.title: Evaluation of the acceleration of orthodontic movements by applying low-level laser therapy. A randomized clinical trial
must_reads.title_zh: 低能量激光治疗加速正畸牙齿移动的评估：一项随机对照试验
must_reads.one_line: LLLT（980nm）显著提升骨转换标志物水平并加速成人犬齿远中移动约30%（p<0.001），提示光生物调节可促进正…
must_reads.so_what: 提示光生物调节可调控骨代谢，对种植骨结合或生物材料界面研究有启发。
must_reads.caution: 样本量未报告，长期效果及最佳参数需进一步验证。
must_reads.abstract: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Adult orthodontic treatment is often prolonged due to biological factors. This randomized split-mouth clinical trial evaluated the effects of low-level laser therapy (LLLT) on orthodontic tooth movement in adults by assessing osteocalcin (OC) and N-telopeptide (NTx) levels as biomarkers of bone remodeling, together with the rate of canine distalization. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Thirty adults (18-35 years) requiring extraction of the maxillary first premolars and canine distalization were included. LLLT (980 nm, 1000 mW, 15 s/point) was applied to selected hemiarches immediately after appliance activation and every two weeks for four months. Gingival crevicular fluid samples were collected before, and 14 days after activation to determine OC and NTx concentrations by ELISA. Canine distalization was measured monthly over four months. RESULTS: Laser-treated hemiarches showed a significant increase in OC levels compared with baseline (mean difference 0.251 ng/mL, p < 0.0001), whereas changes in control hemiarches were not significant. NTx concentrations also increased significantly following orthodontic activation and were higher in laser-treated than control hemiarches (1.374 ± 0.400 vs. 1.169 ± 0.325 ng/mL, p < 0.0001). After four months, canine distalization was significantly greater in laser-treated hemiarches (4.95 ± 0.64 mm) than in controls (3.79 ± 0.56 mm, p < 0.001). CONCLUSIONS: LLLT enhanced bone remodeling by stimulating both bone formation and resorption, resulting in accelerated orthodontic tooth movement. CLINICAL RELEVANCE: These findings support LLLT as a promising adjunctive approach for reducing treatment time and contribute to the evidence needed to optimize laser-assisted orthodontic protocols.

deep.title_zh: 低能量激光治疗加速正畸牙齿移动的评估：一项随机对照试验
deep.one_sentence: LLLT（980nm）显著提升骨转换标志物水平并加速成人犬齿远中移动约30%（p<0.001），提示光生物调节可促进正…
deep.question: 光生物调节能否通过调控局部骨转换平衡（成骨与破骨耦联）加速生理性牙齿移动？其剂量-效应关系及安全性边界如何界定？
deep.design: 双盲随机对照分裂口试验：30名受试者上下颌各一侧为治疗侧（10次/疗程），另一侧为对照侧，随访4个月每月测量犬齿位置并采集龈沟液检测骨标志物。
deep.sample_desc: 30名成人患者（18-35岁）需拔除上颌第一前磨牙并行犬齿远中移动，来源摘要未说明

findings.claim: LLLT显著提高激光侧OC水平（骨形成标志物）
findings.evidence: 均值差0.251 ng/mL，p<0.0001；对照组无显著变化

findings.claim: LLLT提高NTx水平（骨吸收标志物）且在激光侧高于对照侧
LLLT组犬齿远中移动距离更大

deep.effect: 牙齿移动速率增幅约30.6%（(4.95-3.79)/3.79）；效应量摘要未报告Cohen's d或OR值
deep.relation: 与q4最相关：生物材料/物理因子'编程'宿主免疫反应改变骨再生结局。本研究提供光刺激替代化学干预的案例，但聚焦成骨/破骨耦联而非巨噬细胞极化或NETs等免疫微环境机制。
deep.why: 首次以分半口RCT设计直接验证LLLT对成人正畸移动的临床效应，同时监测OC与NTx两个互补标志物证实骨重建加速而非单纯骨吸收亢进，这对'光生物调节是否真正优化骨转换节律'提供了首个人体证据。
limitations: 仅报告短期4个月结果，牙齿移动后的稳定性及复发风险未知
单一激光参数（980nm/1000mW/15s）无法排除其他波长或能量的非劣效/优效性，剂量-效应关系空白
未检测龈沟液中免疫细胞因子（IL-1β、TNF-α、RANKL/OPG），无法解析LLLT是否通过调控巨噬细胞极化发挥成骨作用
deep.transferable: 分半口RCT设计可直接迁移至种植体周炎预防（种植体+软组织的激光辅助抗炎方案）或骨移植材料的加速整合研究；OC+NTx联合监测可作为任何骨转换干预措施的标准化生物学终点。
followups: 该参数的最佳治疗窗口是什么？不同波长（如810nm vs 980nm）和组织穿透深度的比较证据在哪？
LLLT对骨转换标志物的影响是否具有持续放大效应还是出现耐受平台？延长随访能否分离出早期加速期与后期稳态期的差异？
该效应是否在骨密度降低人群（如绝经后女性）中减弱或消失？是否需要预先筛选'响应型'亚群？

glossary.cn: 低能量激光治疗（又称光生物调节疗法）
骨钙素——成骨细胞特异性分泌蛋白，反映骨形成活性
I型胶原氨基端肽桥——骨吸收标志物，代表骨基质降解速率
分半口设计——同一患者两侧接受不同干预的对照形式

scan.title: Effects of Flap Management and Membrane Fixation on Augmented Ridge Dimensions in Guided Bone Regeneration: A Preclinical In Vivo Study
scan.title_zh: GBR中皮瓣管理与膜固定的交互效应
scan.one_line: 2×2析因设计，犬非contained缺损12周micro-CT证实皮瓣释放×膜固定存在显著交互
scan.so_what: q1/q4的实验设计框架可直接迁移：析因设计+split-mouth+micro-CT定量，n=6…
scan.abstract: OBJECTIVES: To investigate the main effects of flap management and membrane fixation and their interaction on augmented ridge dimensions 12 weeks after guided bone regeneration (GBR) in chronic noncontained defects. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Implants were placed into chronic noncontained defects in six male dogs using a split-mouth 2 × 2 factorial design (n = 6 sites per condition). Buccal defects were augmented with particulate bone substitute and resorbable collagen membranes and assigned to four groups based on the stabilization strategy: retentive flap (limited periosteal release) with or without membrane fixation (Ret-F, Ret-UF) and extensive flap release with or without membrane fixation (Ex-F, Ex-UF). Augmented ridge dimensions and tissue composition were assessed using micro-computed tomography and histomorphometric analyses at 12 weeks. RESULTS: Flap × fixation interactions were identified for micro-CT augmented ridge area (p = 0.015) and volume (p = 0.005) and for several histomorphometric outcomes. A flap main effect occurred only at 5-mm augmented tissue width (p = 0.033). Micro-CT volume was greater for Ret-UF than for Ex-UF (difference, 106.70 mm3; p = 0.029) and for Ex-F than for Ex-UF (114.65 mm3; p = 0.021). Micro-CT area was greater for Ex-F than for Ex-UF (8.072 mm2; p = 0.042), and tissue width at 5 mm was greater for Ret-UF than for Ex-UF (2.442 mm; p = 0.015). CONCLUSION: In this exploratory study, flap management and membrane fixation had context-dependent associations with augmented dimensions. Limited release without fixation and extensive release with fixation showed greater dimensions than extensive release without fixation in selected comparisons.

scan.title: Betel-Quid Exposure and Site-Specific Prognostic Patterns in Oral Cavity Squamous Cell Carcinoma
scan.title_zh: 槟榔暴露与口腔鳞癌部位特异性预后
scan.domain: 口腔鳞癌的免疫微环境与微…
scan.one_line: 回顾性队列显示槟榔咀嚼与颊黏膜等亚部位癌症风险相关，DOI阈值因状态而异（7mm vs 15mm）。
scan.so_what: 提供部位特异性预后数据，但对免疫微环境机制无直接启示。
scan.caution: 回顾性设计无法确认因果，人群为泰国南部。
scan.abstract: OBJECTIVE: Betel-quid chewing is a risk factor for oral cavity squamous cell carcinoma (OCSCC), but its associations with tumour subsite and depth-of-invasion (DOI) related prognosis remain unclear. We examined site-specific associations and exposure-stratified DOI thresholds for disease-specific survival (DSS). METHODS: This retrospective cohort included 454 patients from southern Thailand. Tumour-subsite associations were assessed using multivariable logistic regression. Exploratory DSS thresholds were derived among surgically treated patients using maximally selected log-rank statistics and evaluated with an exposure-stratified Cox model. RESULTS: Of 454 patients, 154 (33.9%) were betel chewers. Exposure was associated with tumours of the buccal mucosa (adjusted odds ratio, 5.43), lip (3.96), retromolar trigone (3.28) and gingiva (3.13), relative to oral tongue tumours. Exploratory DOI thresholds were 7 mm in chewers (log-rank p = 0.006) and 15 mm in non-chewers (p 7 mm remained associated with poorer DSS in chewers (hazard ratio, 3.55; 95% confidence interval, 1.32-9.52; p = 0.012), whereas the association for DOI > 15 mm in non-chewers was attenuated (hazard ratio, 1.56; 95% confidence interval, 0.97-2.53; p = 0.069). CONCLUSIONS: Betel-quid exposure was associated with OCSCC at quid-contact subsites. Chewers showed a lower exploratory DOI threshold for DSS than non-chewers.

scan.title: Self-Reported Dysphagia in Head and Neck Cancer Survivors From Diagnosis to Twelve Months Post Treatment and Predictors for Moderate to Severe Long-Term Dysphagia
scan.title_zh: 头颈癌幸存者吞咽困难自我管理报告
scan.one_line: 头颈癌治疗期间吞咽相关生活质量下降，手术联合放化疗是严重长期吞咽困难的风险因素。
scan.so_what: 仅背景信息，对机制或实验设计无帮助。
scan.caution: 问卷调查，主观报告可能有偏差。
scan.abstract: BACKGROUND: Dysphagia is a common complication of head and neck cancer (HNC) and its treatment. This study examined swallowing-related quality of life from diagnosis to 12 months after treatment, compared swallowing outcomes across tumor sites and treatment modalities, and identified predictors of moderate-to-severe dysphagia. METHODS: The M. D. Anderson Dysphagia Inventory (MDADI) was completed by 445 patients receiving curatively intended HNC treatment pre-treatment and at 3-, 6-, and 12-months post-treatment. RESULTS: Swallowing-related quality of life worsened during treatment, the poorest scores at 3 months post-treatment; 21.6% reported moderate-to-severe dysphagia, decreasing to 12.5% at 12 months. Risk factors for dysphagia at 12 months included stage IV disease, surgery combined with (chemo)radiotherapy, smoking cessation within 12 months, and pre-treatment sick leave. Patients with cervical carcinoma of unknown primary (CCUP) had the poorest outcomes. CONCLUSIONS: Swallowing function declined during treatment. Patients receiving surgery combined with (chemo)radiotherapy and patients with CCUP are at increased risk of long-term dysphagia and require closer follow-up.

scan.title: Whiter Is Not Necessarily Better Matched: A 12-Month CIEDE2000 and Dental Whiteness Reanalysis of Intracoronal Bleaching
scan.title_zh: 内漂白色彩匹配再分析
scan.one_line: 内漂白后更高白度值不一定意味着更好的天然牙匹配，过氧化氢组颜色变化更大。
scan.so_what: 仅背景，对研究课题无直接意义。
scan.caution: 观察性再分析，推广需谨慎。
scan.abstract: OBJECTIVES: To determine whether color displacement, dental whiteness, longitudinal dynamics, and natural-tooth matching represent equivalent outcomes after intracoronal bleaching. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This post hoc secondary reanalysis used archived individual CIELAB coordinates from NCT02718183, comparing 35% hydrogen peroxide (HP) with 37% carbamide peroxide (CP) applied using four weekly walking-bleach sessions. CIEDE2000 (ΔE00), Whiteness Index for Dentistry (WID), baseline-referenced ΔWID, consecutive inter-visit changes, and paired treated-versus-homologous tooth mismatch were calculated through 12 months. Linear mixed-effects models used all available observations. Participant-specific homologous-tooth coordinates were available for 38 teeth. RESULTS: At 12 months, mean ΔE00 was 10.45 ± 4.50 for HP and 7.65 ± 2.58 for CP, whereas ΔWID was 27.21 ± 13.03 and 24.48 ± 11.09, respectively. Across post-baseline assessments, HP produced a greater ΔE00 than CP (equal-weight marginal contrast 2.12; 95% CI 0.16 to 4.09; p = 0.034), whereas between-treatment effects were not significant for WID or ΔWID. At 12 months, paired ΔE00match was 7.25 ± 2.23 for HP and 6.13 ± 4.09 for CP. The highest observed WID coincided with the minimum ΔE00match in only 5/38 teeth (13.2%); in 24/38 teeth (63.2%), maximum whiteness occurred after the closest observed natural match. Between 6 and 12 months, near-zero mean signed ΔWID concealed substantial individual absolute changes. CONCLUSIONS: Color displacement, dental whiteness, longitudinal dynamics, and natural-tooth matching were non-equivalent outcomes. Maximum whitening rarely coincided with closest natural-tooth matching. CLINICAL SIGNIFICANCE: Intracoronal bleaching should not be judged solely by the magnitude of whitening. Participant-specific natural-tooth matching together with sustained inter-visit stability warrants prospective evaluation as an individualized treatment endpoint.

scan.title: CDKN1A Mediates Regulated Cell Death in Osteoblasts and Exacerbates Periapical Bone Destruction in Apical Periodontitis
scan.title_zh: 孟德尔随机化在牙髓病学因果推断的应用综述
scan.one_line: 系统梳理MR概念框架、instrument选择、敏感性分析及已发表牙髓病MR研究
scan.so_what: q2的因果推断核心方法学指南，直接影响后续课题设计和审稿回复策略
scan.caution: 综述非原始研究，需自行掌握TwoSampleMR/R代码落地
scan.abstract: BACKGROUND: Apical periodontitis is a chronic inflammatory bone-destructive disease driven by intracanal microbial infection and host immune-inflammatory responses. Periapical bone destruction arises not only from excessive osteoclastic resorption but also from osteoblast dysfunction and dysregulated regulated cell death (RCD). CDKN1A (p21) is a canonical cell-cycle regulator implicated in multiple RCD programs, yet its role in osteoblast injury and apical periodontitis pathogenesis remains undefined. METHODS: Single-cell RNA sequencing (ScRNA) was used to profile osteoblast subpopulations and RCD-related gene expression in human periapical lesions. Porphyromonas gingivalis infection models were established in MG63 and MC3T3-E1 osteoblasts, and DIA proteomics and western blot were used to evaluate RCD-related proteins. The effects of CDKN1A, a disease-associated hub gene screened out in DIA proteomics, on RCD-related proteins were further examined by western blot. Lentiviral silencing and AAV-mediated overexpression were performed in vitro and in rat apical periodontitis models. Bone destruction, RCD activation and osteogenic capacity were assessed by micro-CT, histomorphology and multiplex immunofluorescence. RESULTS: ScRNA data of apical periodontitis showed that osteoblasts in apical lesions exhibited enhanced apoptosis and pyroptosis and reduced ferroptosis. Single-bacteria P. gingivalis infection markedly upregulated CDKN1A, which promoted osteoblast apoptosis and pyroptosis while suppressing necroptosis and ferroptosis. In vivo, CDKN1A expression increased with disease progression and was negatively correlated with the osteogenic marker OPN. CDKN1A overexpression aggravated bone destruction, whereas its knockdown significantly attenuated bone loss and restored osteogenic activity. CONCLUSION: CDKN1A acts as a critical regulator that mediates RCD of osteoblasts, impairs osteogenesis and exacerbates periapical bone destruction in apical periodontitis. Targeting CDKN1A-mediated RCD represents a promising therapeutic strategy to limit bone destruction and promote repair in apical periodontitis.

scan.title: Prognostic value of pre-treatment nodal appearance, volume and kinetics in High-Risk non-HPV related oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma
scan.title_zh: 高危非HPV口咽鳞癌淋巴结预后价值
scan.domain: 口腔鳞癌的免疫微环境与微…
scan.one_line: 高危非HPV口咽鳞癌治疗前淋巴结生长缓慢，影像间隔时间与预后无关。
scan.so_what: 为放疗去escalation提供依据，但未涉及免疫微环境。
scan.caution: 单中心回顾性研究，可能存在选择偏倚。
scan.abstract: PURPOSE: We investigated the risk and prognostic value of pre-treatment nodal progression to inform the safe de-escalation of elective nodal irradiation (ENI) in high-risk oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC). METHODS: We identified patients with p16-negative, clinical T4, node-positive OPSCC treated consecutively with definitive radiotherapy between 2008 and 2021 from a prospectively maintained database. Pre-treatment diagnostic scans were compared against simulation scans to evaluate nodal disease based on pre-specified criteria, growth kinetics, and imaging-detected extranodal extension (iENE). Association of nodal factors and oncologic outcomes were assessed using regression models. RESULTS: A total of 79 patients with a median 30-day interval between diagnostic and simulation scan were identified. Nodal growth was minimal with a median absolute change of + 0.5 cc and growth rate of 0.3%/day. Nodal kinetics and duration between imaging were not prognostic for treatment response. While no patients developed de novo pathological nodal disease, 14% of patients had indeterminant nodes on diagnostic scan, with 27% of these becoming pathological at time of simulation. Total nodal volume was highly correlated with presence of iENE, and was prognostic for locoregional failure (HR = 1.02, p = 0.03), distant failure (HR = 1.02, p = 0.02), and progression-free survival (HR = 1.02, p = 0.05). All regional failures were in-field of high dose treatment volumes. CONCLUSIONS: Pre-treatment nodal disease volume, but not growth kinetics, was a prognostic factor in locally advanced OPSCC. While lack of new nodal disease and minimal growth over a 30-day pre-treatment interval supports the investigation of novel timing of ENI, particular care should be taken in patients to identify and appropriately manage indeterminate nodes at risk for progression.

scan.title: Adjunctive Use of Azithromycin to Non-Surgical Periodontal Therapy: Rationale and Evidence for Its Use in Periodontitis-A Scoping Review
scan.title_zh: 阿奇霉素辅助牙周治疗的宿主调节证据
scan.one_line: 汇总57项研究的scoping review，阿奇霉素 adjunct 对深袋有益但证据不一致
scan.so_what: q1的宿主调节思路可参考，但结论不足以改变用药决策
scan.caution: 回顾性纳入异质性大，多数为small RCT，证据层级不高
scan.abstract: BACKGROUND: Antimicrobials are added as adjuncts to non-surgical periodontal therapy in certain cases to achieve improved outcomes. Among the adjunct antimicrobials that have gained renewed interest is azithromycin, owing to its additional anti-inflammatory and host-modulating properties. This review aims to summarise the pharmacology, adverse effects, and the current evidence for the adjunct use of azithromycin in different forms of periodontitis. METHODS: In vitro studies, randomized controlled trials, and longitudinal studies published in English were searched in MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science and Google Scholar (https://osf.io/m8enj/overview). Following screening of 677 articles, 70 articles were subjected to full-text review and ultimately 57 articles were included. RESULTS: In vitro studies demonstrated anti-bacterial, host-modulating, and anti-inflammatory properties of azithromycin with drug concentrating in inflamed tissues. The additional benefits of adjunctive azithromycin are moderate and inconsistent, although deep periodontal pockets may show enhanced improvements. Local delivery of azithromycin demonstrated additional benefits in single-rooted teeth. CONCLUSION: Azithromycin may provide clinical and microbiological benefits, especially in deep periodontal pockets. However, the World Health Organization categorizes azithromycin as a critically important antimicrobial for human medicine. Due to inconsistent results and owing to the importance of azithromycin, the adjunctive use of azithromycin with non-surgical periodontal therapy is currently not recommended.

scan.title: Bioactive Peptide HX-12C Ameliorates Oral Submucous Fibrosis via Inhibition of TGF-β/Smad-Driven Myofibroblast Activation: A Potential Therapeutic Strategy
scan.one_line: HX-12C肽结合TGFBR1抑制Smad2/3磷酸化，在体内外改善OSF胶原沉积
scan.so_what: TGF-β/Smad在q2牙周炎纤维化、q4材料界面响应中均为核心通路，方法可迁移
scan.caution: 体外→体内跨度大，未验证选择性
scan.abstract: OBJECTIVES: To investigate the anti-fibrotic effects and mechanism of action of the bioactive peptide HX-12C in oral submucous fibrosis. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Primary human buccal mucosal fibroblasts were treated with arecoline to induce a myofibroblast phenotype. The effects of HX-12C on cell proliferation, migration and fibrotic markers were assessed. Molecular docking and immunofluorescence were used to examine HX-12C binding to transforming growth factor-beta receptor I, validated by the inhibitor SB-431542. In vivo efficacy was evaluated in a bleomycin-induced rat model of oral submucous fibrosis. RESULTS: HX-12C promoted fibroblast proliferation and migration but suppressed arecoline-induced myofibroblast activation, downregulating alpha-smooth muscle actin, fibronectin and collagens I/III. Mechanistically, HX-12C bound to transforming growth factor-beta receptor I, inhibited SMAD2/3 phosphorylation and downstream pro-fibrotic gene expression, effects attenuated by SB-431542. In vivo, HX-12C improved mouth opening and reduced collagen deposition. CONCLUSIONS: HX-12C exerts potent anti-fibrotic effects by directly targeting transforming growth factor-beta receptor I and inhibiting the canonical transforming growth factor-beta/Smad signalling pathway. Our findings identify HX-12C as a promising therapeutic candidate for oral submucous fibrosis and provide a rationale for developing peptide-based therapies for transforming growth factor-beta-driven fibrotic diseases.
